names.note: Name page 9186 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Афанасий (Егоров), игумен, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line giving only the bare genitive «Афанасия» after «прмч.». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; `leo-egorov` and `tatiana-egorova` carry the same surname and different forenames.

death.note: The company's line closes «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives for him; no year of birth anywhere, and no life page behind his name.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 августа ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Александра, Петра, Михаила, Иоанна, Димитрия и Алексия пресвитеров, Елисея диакона и прмч. Афанасия (1937).»

attestations.note: Eighth and last of the names the day's fourteenth entry enumerates, and the only one the line gives its own rank: «прмч.», преподобномученик, venerable-martyr, where the other seven stand under the opening «Сщмчч.». TWO RANKS DISAGREE AND BOTH ARE RECORDED: the line says «прмч.» and name page 9186 says «сщмч.», and `venerable-martyr` is taken from the line, which is the entry that keeps him, with `abbot` from the page's «игумен». THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: his name carries no life link. `ls -d saints/*egorov*` returned `leo-egorov` and `tatiana-egorova`, both different forenames. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
